question: Do frozen UMAP financial peers have stronger subsequent daily return co-movement than sector peers and formation-characteristic-matched cross-cluster alternatives?
status: Retrospective protocol recorded before executing this validation; not a prospective preregistration.
model: Existing representative seed-42 UMAP assignments; no refitting or configuration selection using forward returns.
primary_return_basis: Yahoo adjusted close daily simple returns (dividend/split-adjusted vendor series)
formation_universe: All 41 instruments observed at each formation date, retained after index exit; no conditioning on next-date index membership.
economic_units: INL and INP are one Investec group for focal-company weighting; exclude their mutual pair.
primary_statistic: For each focal instrument, mean within-cluster correlation minus mean same-sector correlation; average available instrument contrasts within corporate group, then equally across groups. Same-sector pairs may overlap cluster pairs.
matched_control: For every directed focal/cluster-peer pair, choose a cross-cluster alternative for the same focal instrument with the peer's recorded sector, nearest in formation-date standardised log line market capitalisation and annualised volatility. Matching with replacement; report unmatched targets and distance/reuse diagnostics. Match before evaluating correlations.
other_control: All eligible cross-cluster peers, company balanced.
high_volatility_sensitivity: Exclude instruments strictly above the formation cross-section's 90th percentile of annualised volatility, without using forward volatility.
other_sensitivities: J200-residual adjusted returns, with a same-window intercept and market slope removed
uncertainty: Per-date synchronous circular moving-block bootstrap of the entire return panel. Also recompute after deleting each economic company, including rematching. No pairwise independent-observation t tests and no inference from two dates as an independent large sample.
price_quality: Require positive finite prices and complete common-calendar returns. Flag and stop on any absolute daily constituent or J200 return above 40 percent; do not silently trim. The separate beta audit's J203 cleaning does not apply to this test.
interpretation: Conditional retrospective financial validation, not a trading backtest, causal test, certified point-in-time forecast or proof of generalisation. Two windows and legacy sectors limit inference. Do not change model choice according to these results.
